sources.title: Besimple OSS - GitHub
sources.snippet: Besimple OSS Open-source work from Besimple, focused on helping teams ship voice models faster. Besimple provides licensed audio data, expert annotation, and voice talent for training and evaluating voice AI.

sources.title: Inkling - Thinking Machines Lab
sources.snippet: Inkling-Small is shown with a solid purple line, Inkling with the heavier cobalt line, and the comparison models with dashed lines. Evaluations without a reported model score are plotted at zero. Hover an evaluation to compare every model's score.

sources.title: Besimple AI: Voice data for AI | Y Combinator
sources.snippet: With Besimple, you can generate your own platform for annotating AI eval and training data instantly. Simply paste or stream any type of raw data and we'll instantly generate a tailored annotation interface, clear guidelines, an automated human-in-the-loop workflow, and AI judges to scale your insights.
